```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

pacman::p_load(gtsummary, gt, install = FALSE)

conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
```

## Overview

This document creates covariate tables summarizing demographic and blood cell composition characteristics stratified by dementia transition categories.

## Introduction

This notebook is to create a covariate table for the subjects used in the OLS association analysis.

## Load data

### Signifcant CpG sites

Read the data of signifcant CG sites.

```{r}
#| label: load-data

# glimpse(sig_cg[1:6])
```


### Meth data

DNA meth tibble, one subject per row (n=2602, AGES1), covariates (n=20 besides subr_id18) and CpG (n > 800k) as columns. Keep only the significant CpG sites.

```{r}
#| label: Read DNAm data

tic("Read DNAm data")
m <- read_rds(here("data/collaborator_only/covariates_and_meth_DMP_on_chr21.rds")) |>
  # Exclude subjects with missing smoking status (n=5)
  filter(!is.na(a1smokingstatus))
  # Keep relevant columns
  # dplyr::select(subr_id18, a1age, sex, a1smokingstatus, dementia_ages1_eos, any_of(colnames(sig_cg)))
  # dplyr::select(subr_id18, a1age, sex, a1smokingstatus, dementia_ages1_eos, any_of(sig_cg$cg))
toc()

glimpse(m)
```

### Blood cell composition

```{r}
#| label: Read blood cell composition

comp <-
  read_csv(here("data/collaborator_only/blood_cell_composition.csv")) |>
  # Only keep AGES1, i.e., cohort = "I"
  filter(cohort == "I") |>
  # Select columns of blood cell composition, and subr_id18
  select(subr_id18, Bcell:NK)

glimpse(comp)
```


## Merge

Merge the methylation data with blood cell composition.

```{r}
d_merged <- m |> 
  left_join(comp, by="subr_id18") |> 
  # Move cell composition after dementia_ages1_eos
  relocate(Bcell:NK, .after = dementia_ages1_eos) |> 
  # Convert subr_id18 to character
  mutate(subr_id18 = as.character(subr_id18)) #|>
  # Left join APOE data
#   left_join(apo, by="subr_id18") |> 
#   relocate(contains("apoe"), .after = dementia_ages1_eos)

glimpse(d_merged[, 1:20])
```


## Clean the data

```{r}
#| label: clean-data
#| eval: false

d_clean <- d_merged |> 
  # Remove variable labels
  remove_labels() |>
  # Rename variables
  rename(
    dementia_transition = dementia_ages1_eos,
    smoking_status = a1smokingstatus,
    age = a1age
  )

# labelled::var_label(d_clean)
glimpse(d_clean)
```


```{r}

d_clean <- d_merged |> 
  # Rename variables
  rename(
    dementia_transition = dementia_ages1_eos,
    smoking_status = a1smokingstatus,
    age = a1age
  ) |>
  # Add variable labels
  labelled::set_variable_labels(
    dementia_transition = "Dementia transition",
    age = "Age",
    sex = "Sex",
    smoking_status = "Smoking status",
    Bcell = "B cell",
    CD4T = "CD4T cell",
    CD8T = "CD8T cell",
    Eos = "Eos cell",
    Mono = "Mono cell",
    Neu = "Neu cell"
  ) |> 
  # Relabel factor levels
  mutate(
    sex = fct_recode(sex, "Male" = "M", "Female" = "F"),
    smoking_status = fct_recode(smoking_status, "Non-smoker" = "no", "Former smoker" = "former", "Current smoker" = "curr")
  )

glimpse(d_clean)
```


## Examplar CpG site 1

### Select the first CpG site
```{r}
#| label: select_cg1

# Pin the exemplar CpG sites cited in the manuscript (Supplementary Table) so
# the figure reproduces regardless of CpG column order in the input data.
cg_site1 <- "cg12179179"

cg_site1
```

### Run the model

```{r}
#| label: run_lm1

model_1 <- glue( "{cg_site1} ~ dementia_transition + age + sex + smoking_status + Bcell + CD4T + CD8T + Eos + Mono + Neu + Mono") |> 
  as.formula()  |> 
  lm(data = d_clean) |> 
  tbl_regression()

model_1
``` 


### Save the model

```{r}
#| label: save-model1

fs::dir_create(here("demographics/output"))
model_1 |>
  write_rds(file = here(glue("demographics/output/{cg_site1}_examplar_model.rds"))) |>
  as_gt() |>
  gtsave(file = here(glue("demographics/output/{cg_site1}_examplar_model.png")), expand = 10, vwidth = 1600, vheight = 1200, zoom = 2)

```

## Covariate table

### Create the table

```{r}
#| label: covariate_table

# With dementia_transition
covariate_table_with_dementia <- d_clean |> 
  select(dementia_transition, age, sex, smoking_status, Bcell, CD4T, CD8T, Eos, Mono, Neu, Mono) |> 
  tbl_summary()

covariate_table_with_dementia

# Without dementia_transition
covariate_table_without_dementia <- d_clean |> 
  select(age, sex, smoking_status, Bcell, CD4T, CD8T, Eos, Mono, Neu, Mono) |> 
  tbl_summary()

covariate_table_without_dementia
```

### Save the table

```{r}
#| label: save-table

# With dementia_transition
covariate_table_with_dementia |> 
  write_rds(file = here("demographics/output/covariate_table_with_dementia.rds")) |>
  as_gt() |>
  gtsave(file = here("demographics/output/covariate_table_with_dementia.png"), expand = 10, vwidth = 1600, vheight = 1200, zoom = 2)

# Without dementia_transition
covariate_table_without_dementia |>
  write_rds(file = here("demographics/output/covariate_table_without_dementia.rds")) |>
  as_gt() |>
  gtsave(file = here("demographics/output/covariate_table_without_dementia.png"), expand = 10, vwidth = 1600, vheight = 1200, zoom = 2)
```


## Covariate table by dementia transition

### Prepare data

Ensure dementia_transition factor levels are in the correct order.

```{r}
#| label: prepare-data-by-transition

d_by_transition <- d_clean |>
  mutate(
    dementia_transition = fct_relevel(
      dementia_transition,
      "stable_normal", "normal2mci", "stable_mci", "normal2incid", "mci2incid", "prev"
    )
  )
```

### Create the table

```{r}
#| label: covariate-table-by-transition

covariate_table_by_transition <- d_by_transition |>
  select(dementia_transition, age, sex, smoking_status, Bcell, CD4T, CD8T, Eos, Mono, Neu) |>
  tbl_summary(
    by = dementia_transition,
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    missing = "ifany",
    missing_text = "Missing"
  ) |>
  add_p(
    test = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "kruskal.test",
      all_categorical() ~ "chisq.test"
    )
  ) |>
  add_overall(last = FALSE) |>
  bold_labels()

covariate_table_by_transition
```

### Save the table

```{r}
#| label: save-table-by-transition

covariate_table_by_transition |>
  write_rds(file = here("demographics/output/covariate_table_by_dementia_transition.rds")) |>
  as_gt() |>
  gtsave(
    file = here("demographics/output/covariate_table_by_dementia_transition.png"),
    expand = 10,
    vwidth = 1400,
    vheight = 1000,
    zoom = 2
  )
```
